content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (medium severity, restrictive covenants).**

- **Issue:** Clause 12.4 (§ 12 Customer Responsibilities) is a one-way covenant binding only us: an 18-month post-termination bar on soliciting **or engaging** *any* person employed by Vendor at any time during the term, with no carve-outs.
- **Why it fails the playbook:** not mutual; 18 months exceeds our 12-month cap; scope covers all Vendor personnel rather than those involved in the Services; "engage" operates as a prohibited no-hire; and there is no general-advertising / unsolicited-approach carve-out. It also directly contradicts clause 12.3, which confirms we have made no no-hire commitment and may hire persons responding to general recruitment.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** delete clause 12.4 to reach the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), with the fallback — mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, plus general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire — offered in the comment for negotiation.
